The '''Battle of Skye''', also known as the '''Battle of Marat V,''' was a conflict during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]].

== Prelude ==
During the early [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[mutant]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]] pledged his fealty to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]] and loaned his scientific expertise to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] war machine. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Sidious tasked Magnus with subjugating a neutral world in a plot to draw [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] closer to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] would be [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Magnus, leaving Anakin ripe for tutelage under Sidious. Magnus complied by dispatching [[Zeta Magnus (clone)|a clone of himself]] to the neutral planet [[Skye/Legends|Marat V]] (known as Skye by its [[S'kytri|natives]]), but he planned to trick Sidious by returning an Anakin [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] loyal only to him to the Dark Lord. The Zeta Magnus clone seduced the S’kytri of the [[Outland Clan]] with the promise of agricultural advancements and the reversal of their skin pigmentation to elevate their standing in the S’kytri’s discriminatory society. He instead unleashed a [[Disease/Legends|plague]] upon them, transforming the Outlanders into [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]]-like mutants. Zeta Magnus used his newly [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] army of mutants to subjugate the other clans and declare himself the Magister of Skye.<ref name="swcw">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> 

After [[Patriarch (Skye)|Patriarch]] [[Klarymére]] transmitted a plea to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] requesting them to help free his people from the mutant tyrant, the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] tasked a team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to arrest Zeta Magnus unharmed. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Obi-Wan Kenobi, [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] Anakin Skywalker, Jedi Padawan [[Halagad Ventor]], and a [[Tark Squad|squad]] of [[Thyrsian]] clones disguised as [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] that had been secretly inserted into the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] by Zeta Magnus were transported to Skye by the [[MedStar-class frigate/Legends|MedStar frigate]] ''[[Golandras]]'' under the guise of a mercy mission, sending medical supplies to the starving, plague-stricken natives. Upon exiting [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the ship entered a [[Cloaked mine|cloaked minefield]] and was critically damaged. The ship’s [[Brisha Shard|captain]] ejected the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] containing the task force just before the ship exploded. Once the team safely crash-landed, they were intercepted by Patriarch Klarymére and brought before the [[Supreme Council of the Highland Clans]]. While the Council was hesitant to accept help from the suspicious newcomers, the Jedi convinced them to mobilize for an assault against the Magnus’ [[Kharys' fortress|citadel]].<ref name="swcw" />

Not long after this meeting, Zeta Magnus broadcast his demands over the Republic [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]. He claimed the Jedi Council had invaded his sovereign territory to sabotage Marat’s petition to the [[Council of Neutral Systems/Legends|Council of Neutral Systems]], illegally depose him, and confiscate Marat V’s [[bloodstone]] as a war resource. He also claimed that the ''Golandras'' had unleashed a plague upon Marat V that turned two-thirds of the planet’s population against him. Zeta Magnus granted the Republic twenty-four [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] to recognize his sovereignty, or he would release [[Jurr-5]], [[Brainrot Plague|brainrot]], [[trihexalon-based rooze]], or some other mutagenic pathogen on a random Republic world thereat and repeating every cycle thereafter.<ref name="swcw" /> 

The Jedi, Tark Squad, and a group of S’kytri nobles rushed to infiltrate Magnus’ citadel via the labyrinthine tunnels of [[Entyrmion]] underneath [[Canaitith Mountain]] before the twenty-four-hour deadline ended. They encountered his [[Oskan blood eater|Oskan blood eaters]] which killed Patriarch Klarymére in the ensuing fighting. Once the team reached the base of the citadel, Klarymére’s daughter [[Kharys]] ordered [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commander]] [[Aragh]] to initiate [[attack plan Vozburk]], an archaic term for all-out war between the Windborn and the ground-dwelling demons of Skye.<ref name="swcw" />

==The battle==
The united [[Highland Clans|Highland]] and [[Lowland Clans|Lowland]] forces led by Wing Commander Aragh besieged Magnus’ citadel from the air. Swarms of biologically altered Outlanders spewed from the tower’s balconies while [[Automated defense system|automated defense turrets]] fired on the flying invaders. The Windborn army engaged the mindless Outlander army like dueling eagles, with claws, swords, and spears. Amid the aerial fighting, the Jedi and their commandos scaled the Canaitith Mountain. They fended off attacks from flying Outlanders, but one penetrated Anakin’s defenses and raked his face, leaving a scar along his left eye. The Jedi reached the balcony and neutralized its automated defenses before cutting into the citadel’s walls. As they penetrated deeper into the citadel, the clones of Tark Squad turned on them and blasted them in the back with [[Stun blaster/Legends|stun blasts]].<ref name="swcw" /> 

When the Jedi awoke, they were detained by a [[R-TechApp Man Trap|man-trap]] in the laboratory dungeon of Zeta Magnus. The mad [[Clone Master/Legends|clone master]] revealed that he had cloned each of the Jedi and planned to [[Mindscan droid|upload their memories]] into the clones before killing them. As Zeta Magnus swung his halberd down to execute the Jedi, Kharys, who had been watching from the laboratory window, used the [[Force power/Legends|Force]] to guide the blade towards the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that had been restraining the Jedi’s mind. The Jedi freed themselves from their captivity while the droid [[Blue-Tark/Legends|Blue-Tark]] and Tark Squad fired on Kharys. Padawan Ventor chased Zeta Magnus to his [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] while Obi-Wan and Anakin were pinned down by [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] fire from the traitorous clone commandos. Ventor attempted to prevent Magnus from boarding [[Skyriver Invader|his ship]] by impaling him with a [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|spike launcher]], but Magnus spun around and took a bite out of him. Before Magnus could eat Ventor, Blue-Tark betrayed him by taking off and igniting him with the thrusters. Ventor took advantage of the distraction to [[Sai tok/Legends|cut Magnus in two]]. Meanwhile, Anakin and Obi-Wan were flushed out from cover by [[Flamethrower/Legends|flame projectors]]. They charged through the flames and engaged the Thyrsian troopers, taking them out one by one. The last clone, [[Nilo (clone commando)|Nilo]], held a [[Class-D detonator]] in his hand, prepared to [[Class-D annihilation|disintegrate]] the Jedi. Before he could throw it, Ventor returned from his duel with Zeta Magnus and detonated the detonator with the Force, vaporizing the half of the laboratory containing the clones of the Jedi.<ref name="swcw" />

==Aftermath==
Following the battle, clone forces led by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] arrived with the ''[[Resolute/Legends|Resolute]]'' to secure the planet. Zeta Magnus' body was carried off to be placed in a [[stasis booth]] [[Entropy field/Legends|entropy field]], while the rest of his equipment and experiments were loaded into Republic [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|gunships]].<ref name="swcw" /> 

The Highland and Lowland clans had suffered untold casulaties in the battle, while much of the Outland Clan had perished. The [[Ministry of Science (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Ministry of Science]] had cultivated an antidote for the biologically altered survivors of the Outland Clan. Speaker [[Nebaél]] promised eternal fealty to the Jedi trio that freed them, but also declared that they would never again welcome ground walkers to their world.<ref name="swcw" /> 

Skywalker sensed that Kharys was still alive and wished to bring her to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for training to pay her back for saving their lives. Kenobi and Ventor believed she was too old and unstable to start on the path of the Jedi and refused to take her. However, Skywalker promised Kharys that he would return one day to train her.<ref name="swcw" /> Following the end of the Clone Wars, Skywalker kept his promise and came back to Skye to take Kharys as his student, except when he did, he was no longer Anakin Skywalker, but Darth Vader, a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. After her training, she returned to rule her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] as Majestrix, taking Zeta Magnus' fortress as her own.

==Behind the scenes==
When this battle was first mentioned in [[Marvel Comics]]' [[Star Wars Annual (1977) 1|''Star Wars Annual'' (1977) 1]], it was before [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] had been released and Darth Vader and Anakin Skywalker being one in the same had yet to be revealed. As a result, Aragh's retelling of the battle to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] during the comic referred to two separate apprentices of Obi-Wan Kenobi who had come to Skye, one of who was Darth Vader. When Luke asked who Obi-Wan's other apprentice was, Aragh said, "You wear his [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]." This apparent inconsistency was [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] in [[2007]]'s ''[[Aliens in the Empire]]''. ''Aliens in the Empire'' revealed that Halagad Ventor and Anakin Skywalker traded [[Concordance of Fealty]] vows and switched lightsabers for their mission to Skye, meaning that the apprentice of Obi-Wan who Aragh saw wield Anakn's lightsaber was in fact Halagad.
